title: Oversize held extract-batch refuses input_bounds
changedFact: before.json (2188 bytes) and after.json (2185 bytes) exceed --max-bytes 200. Engine must refuse input_bounds on STDERR (exit 2), not emit a truncated success.

source.note: Public /privacy selected fields are the held payload. The refusal is the max-bytes bound, not a page-content verdict.
